case: Text array native-value and XML/HTML/Markdown file-writer contract
contract: A text[] containing literal NULL, SQL NULL, empty text, comma, quote, backslash, Unicode and hostile markup retains its PostgreSQL array text and native text[] type.
PostgreSQL array_to_json supplies an independent element oracle that distinguishes literal NULL from SQL NULL; array_send bytes match after a bound text[] round trip.
The XML, HTML and Markdown result-file writers retain Unicode and escape markup so the text[] payload cannot inject markup into the output.
The SQL result-file writer is replayed into a PostgreSQL table; native text, array_to_json and array_send checks confirm exact restoration.
This covers one array family across four result-file formats; other array families and workbook cell semantics remain open.

native_contract.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-postgres value_contract_text_array_file_exports_preserve_text_and_escape_markup -- --ignored --nocapture

clippy.command: rtk proxy cargo clippy --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-postgres --all-targets -- -D warnings

remaining: Other PostgreSQL array families, XLSX cell semantics, broader enum/session configurations, and the remaining B3 engine/type/consumer matrix are unproven.
